en: And that's it for this course. I walked you
through all the key features you need to
know to get the most out of Claude Code and
use it efficiently. And no matter if you
decide to run Claude Code in a loop like the
Rolf loop, or if you prefer working step by
step with plan mode and yourself in the
loop, or maybe a mixture of both,
this course should now have put you in the
position of getting more out of Claude Code
and should prepare you for a future where
software development is, of course, changing
and software is more and more being written
but it's you, the software engineer, that
steers what software is written in which
way. And this course hopefully gave you the
tools to be part of that transition and
efficiently use tools like Claude Code.
